children: The toll in an explosion at Oil India Limited's facility in Assam's Dibrugarh district rose to two, with an engineer succumbing to his burn injuries at a private hospital here, officials said.
A fire broke out on Friday during maintenance work at the OIL's Intermediate Tank Farm in Tengakhat, following the explosion, according to a statement issued by the PSU.
An Intermediate Tank Farm is a facility where petroleum products are temporarily stored in tanks before being transferred for further processing or transportation.
The death of Tapas Jyoti Gogoi, who had been employed by Spectron Engineering Private Limited, a company engaged by Oil India Ltd, was confirmed by its area manager Kamal Phukan on Saturday.
Gogoi, a resident of N Gali in Milan Nagar of Dibrugarh, was among the six workers who sustained burn injuries in the explosion.

title: Toll in explosion at OIL facility in Assam rises to two
